description: This PHP class 'UpdateFetcher' in the Drupal project handles fetching project update data from remote URLs, including constructing fetch URLs, performing HTTP requests with fallback, and managing update settings.

classes.name: UpdateFetcher
classes.description: A class responsible for fetching project update information from remote sources, with support for fallback and configurable URLs.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the fetch URL, HTTP client, update settings, and fallback option based on configuration and settings.

methods.name: fetchProjectData
methods.description: Fetches project data from a remote URL constructed based on project info and site key.

methods.name: doRequest
methods.description: Performs an HTTP GET request with optional fallback from HTTPS to HTTP if errors occur.

methods.name: buildFetchUrl
methods.description: Constructs the URL used to fetch update information, including optional parameters like site key, version, and installed modules.

methods.name: getFetchBaseUrl
methods.description: Determines the base URL for fetching updates, either from project info or default settings.
